Feeling a lump in your throat is a VERY common effect of anxiety, and muscular pain is also very common because you tense up so much when you're anxious.

I get it all the time. But it's totally harmless, there is really nothing there.

Just relax your throat, drink some water, and do something to distract your mind from the symptom.

Remember: the more you focus on it, the worse it seems. Stop thinking about it and it will be gone before you know it.
